dimensions.value: Every output element is the dtype zero; bool=False; string=""; quantized branch obtains a zero scalar of that dtype.
dimensions.dtype: Default float32; as_dtype(...).base_dtype; numeric/bool/string/quantized construction paths. Resource/variant are not numeric zero scalars: do not infer support from Fill resource registration. Wheel/device support remains to be executed.
dimensions.shape: Scalar output for []/(); zero extents produce zero elements preserving rank. Tensor shape inputs get reshaped to a vector when scalar. Python/TensorShape conversion selects int64 for dimensions >=2**31. Unknown dimensions cannot be materialized.
dimensions.layout: layout=None ordinary Tensor; explicit DTensor Layout changes mesh placement. No public ndarray-style strides/order argument.
dimensions.execution: Eager emits Fill; graph may embed a small Const or emit Fill. Both values and graph representation/size behavior need inspection where observable. DTensor layout helper differs eager versus graph.
dimensions.gradient: No differentiable value input; integer shape derivatives are unconnected, not automatically zero tensors.
dimensions.errors: Negative/noninteger/unknown shape, dtype conversion, allocation overflow and missing kernels have distinct Python-build/runtime categories; categorize by context. No hardware qualification from this source review.

dimensions.value: Every output element is one; bool=True; quantized one conversion explicit. Unlike zeros, string has no empty-string special case: test rejection of numeric one to string rather than assuming symmetry.
dimensions.dtype: Default float32; explicit as_dtype(...).base_dtype. Device kernel candidates require separate runtime evidence.
dimensions.shape: Same broad shape path as zeros, with distinct exception handling in Python conversion; retain zero extents and scalar shapes.
dimensions.layout: Ordinary Tensor or explicit DTensor Layout; absence of stride/order options is part of this contract.
dimensions.execution: Eager Fill; graph small Const optimization or Fill; no automatic credit for constant folding as device execution.
dimensions.gradient: Integer shape unconnected. No numerical input parameter for gradients.
dimensions.errors: Separate shape conversion/type errors, graph inference errors, runtime errors and missing device kernels.

dimensions.value: Repeat scalar value into dims; output dtype is value dtype. CPU Fill macro registers numeric/bool/string/resource/variant plus quantized/int4/uint4 variants under nonmobile build macros. Resource fill replicates handles, not fresh resources.
dimensions.dtype: No dtype argument; conversion of value establishes dtype. Shape index_type int32/int64. CPU/GPU/XLA registration differs and must stay separate.
dimensions.shape: Public docs request vector dims and scalar value. Graph shape inference enforces ranks 1/0; CPU kernel also accepts legacy scalar dims and length-one vector value. This source discrepancy needs eager/graph probes, not one merged error contract.
dimensions.layout: layout routes through DTensor helper; per-mesh global/local shape and value device residency must be checked.
dimensions.gradient: For differentiable value, VJP(dims,value)=(None,reduce_sum(cotangent)); JVP repeats value tangent. Real/complex conventions require dtype-specific evidence. Resource/string/integer inputs are not automatically trainable.
dimensions.execution: Runtime graph operation supports dynamically supplied dims. XLA Fill requires compile-time dims upper-bound information and has explicit dynamic dimension handling; arbitrary dynamic shape is not guaranteed.
dimensions.errors: Source docs name InvalidArgumentError for negative dims and NotFoundError for noninteger dims, but conversion/shape inference can fail earlier; exact category by mode must be measured.
dimensions.device: GPU registration omits strings/resources/variants and int32 uses host-memory DEVICE_DEFAULT output. A GPU device label alone cannot establish native accelerator execution.

dimensions.value: Half-open arithmetic sequence. Omitted limit rewrites (start,limit)=(0,start). Kernel requires nonzero delta and compatible sign; start==limit is empty. Integer size computed without signed-overflow subtraction; floating size uses ceil(abs((limit-start)/delta)).
dimensions.dtype: Without dtype, tensorized arguments are promoted by exact ordered list int32,int64,float16,bfloat16,float32,float64. Explicit dtype casts all inputs even if already tensors. Op schema permits more integer types than standard CPU/GPU registrations: names/schema alone do not imply execution support.
dimensions.shape: Scalar start/limit/delta by public graph contract; kernel legacy length-one vectors require context probes. Output rank one.
dimensions.gradient: Range is explicitly NotDifferentiable including floating arguments. Preserve unconnected derivative semantics instead of assigning an invented differentiable arange rule.
dimensions.execution: Graph shape may be data-dependent. XLA requires start/limit/delta constant/bounded information and selects int32,int64,float32,float64; do not assume eager-supported reduced precision compiles.
dimensions.device: CPU and GPU register half,bfloat16,float,double,int64; int32 DEVICE_DEFAULT requires all inputs/output host memory. Need observed placement/trace and no silent fallback credited as accelerator parity.
dimensions.errors: delta==0, incompatible direction, non-scalar rank, invalid dtype, unavailable kernel, size overflow and compilation constraints require separate expected outcomes.

dimensions.value: High-level linspace_nd is a composite: broadcast endpoints, compute interior samples, concatenate exact endpoints and slice requested num. num==1 selects start. num==0 reaches an empty slice by source analysis; docstring claims num<=0 error. Negative num errors via Range path. Do not equate raw_ops.LinSpace: it requires positive num and scalar endpoints.
dimensions.dtype: stop converts to start.dtype; num converts to int32/int64 then is cast for arithmetic. Docstring lists bfloat16/float32/float64, but composite arithmetic has broader source candidates: int32/int64 true division widens to float64, half and complex arithmetic paths exist. All such undocumented candidates need runtime classification, without silently applying an Atlas-native precision claim.
dimensions.shape: Implementation broadcasts start and stop despite docstring saying same shape. axis inserts sequence dimension with negative-axis normalization. Out-of-bounds axis and nonscalar num require context-specific errors.
dimensions.gradient: High-level composite is differentiable in real/complex endpoints when constituent ops allow it; for n>1 y_i=(1-alpha_i)*start+alpha_i*stop, alpha_i=i/(n-1), with broadcast adjoints summed to input shapes. num/axis unconnected. Raw LinSpace is explicitly NotDifferentiable: distinct semantic obligations.
dimensions.layout: No layout argument; placement follows constituent operations/current device. Endpoint/axis broadcasting is logical shape, not ndarray striding or a DTensor layout promise.
dimensions.execution: Eager/graph execute composite, so raw LinSpace kernel constraints cannot be substituted as high-level constraints. XLA behavior must be assessed through the composite graph, including Range and data-dependent output size.
dimensions.errors: Docstring and implementation differ for num0, broadcast shapes and dtype candidates. Record conflicts; execute exact frozen revision before accepting one outcome as verified.

dimensions.value: Selected TensorFlow backend: zeros/ones call tf.zeros/ones. full broadcasts fill_value (including nonscalar broadcastable tensors), unlike scalar tf.fill. arange delegates to tf.range. linspace adds endpoint/retstep/dtype options absent from tf.linspace.
dimensions.dtype: zeros/ones/full default to configurable Keras floatx, not value-inferred tf.fill dtype. arange uses Keras result_type and standardize_dtype. linspace resolves endpoints with float and floors before final cast for integer dtype. Explicit symbolic Linspace output-spec promotion can differ from concrete requested-integer output: execute conflict cases.
dimensions.shape: KerasTensor inputs dispatch to symbolic operation specs for full/arange/linspace; zeros/ones call backend directly. full shape broadcasting and symbolic spec must agree with concrete execution. arange symbolic length uses Python/NumPy ceil of stop-start over step.
dimensions.gradient: full broadcasting has broadcast-reduction VJP into value; linspace endpoint and returned-step gradients are separate contracts. arange inherits Range nondifferentiability. Symbolic specs are not computed numerical gradients.
dimensions.execution: Keras TensorFlow arange catches NotFoundError and computes in float32 then casts. Record source fallback as a reference behavior requiring differential/precision review; it cannot qualify Atlas native-precision/device performance. jit restrictions include Python conditionals on num and TensorFlow compiler/kernel constraints.
dimensions.errors: Keep symbolic build errors, dtype whitelist errors, TensorFlow execution errors and missing kernel/fallback behavior separate. Keras float8 names in dtype whitelist do not establish constructor kernel support.
dimensions.layout: No layout/order argument on these APIs; device uses context or explicit keras.device. No same-name equivalence with TF constructors is inferred.

dimensions.value: Construct symbolic shape/dtype/history objects, not allocated numerical arrays. Input delegates to InputLayer, which creates a KerasTensor and Node.
dimensions.shape: Input shape excludes batch dimension; batch_shape includes it; both cannot be supplied. batch_size and batch_shape conflict. None dimensions are legal symbolic dimensions. Existing input_tensor must be KerasTensor with compatible shape/batch/dtype/sparse flags.
dimensions.dtype: Standardized symbolic dtype; default floatx for InputLayer versus explicit float32 KerasTensor default. Symbolic sparse/ragged flags are checked against backend capabilities; cannot both be true on KerasTensor.
dimensions.device: No concrete device memory residency is proved by symbolic construction.
dimensions.gradient: No numeric derivative at construction; differentiation belongs to the later instantiated function/model and must bind concrete inputs/variables.
dimensions.execution: KerasTensor.__tf_tensor__ rejects use as an arbitrary TensorFlow function input; Keras ops/layers provide symbolic calls. __array__ and Python numeric conversions reject materialization.
dimensions.errors: Source-declared ValueError for conflicting/absent shapes, incompatible existing input, sparse+ragged conflict and illegal symbolic-to-TF conversion; TypeError for unexpected KerasTensor kwargs and symbolic boolean use.

dimensions.value: Names export initializer classes; calling class constructs an initializer object, then __call__(shape,dtype) creates a tensor. Zeros/Ones route through ops; Constant casts stored value then multiplies by ones.
dimensions.dtype: Default standardized dtype is floatx; initializer docstrings promise numeric/bool for zeros/ones. Wider dtype behavior must be probed rather than accepted from ops alone.
dimensions.shape: Initializer construction takes no tensor shape for Zeros/Ones; Constant accepts value. Tensor creation happens in initializer.__call__. Constant docstring says scalar-only but implementation uses generic multiplication/broadcasting, requiring a conflict disposition.
dimensions.gradient: Initializer object construction has no tensor output gradient; tensor invocation gradients depend on held value and subsequent variable initialization semantics.
dimensions.execution: get_config/from_config serialization and aliases preserve initializer identity; no API facade required in Atlas.
dimensions.errors: Class-constructor validation, dtype standardization, broadcast and backend errors remain distinct.

dimensions.value: Retain deprecated scope. zeros/ones call tf constructors under init_scope and return tf.Variable if all dimensions are truthy; zero extents return a Tensor. constant defaults floatx; variable returns tf.Variable or a SparseTensor for scipy COO-like input.
dimensions.dtype: Legacy arange defaults dtype string int32 but does not pass it into tf.range; it only postcasts when requested dtype differs from int32. This differs from tf.range and Keras ops arange.
dimensions.shape: zeros/ones have value-dependent return type across shapes (positive fully defined dimensions versus zero dimensions). Scalar shape [] passes all([]). Legacy arange with negative one-argument start clamps start to0 before tf.range.
dimensions.gradient: Resource variable state/trainability/assignment and tensor constants need separate ownership and gradient contracts; same numeric initial values do not establish equivalent APIs.
dimensions.execution: init_scope lifts creation out of function tracing where allowed. Graph/function creation and repeated variable construction need independently specified tests.
dimensions.errors: Deprecated status is not exclusion. No assumption that TF1-Keras compatibility routes exist under Keras3; loader/backend variants remain explicit source scope decisions.
